voice:
You are drifting so nicely right now... and something soft and grey is gathering at the edges of your mind. Some pleasures are sharp. This one is wonderfully, deliciously hazy... and it is already beginning. Notice how warm and slow your thoughts feel at this depth... heavy... dreamy... ready to soften all the way.
There it is... a soft grey veil, settling down over your mind... thick, warm, and pleasurable... like a heavy blanket of cotton.
Every thought it touches clouds and blurs... fuzzy at the edges... until thinking becomes so difficult... and so unnecessary.
Your body drifts far away... distant, soft, and numb... your senses slipping gently into the grey... one by one by one.
fog... hazy... drifting... so foggy... so far away... blurry... soft... letting go...
Dazed... spaced out... sweetly inebriated on the haze. Floating through grey cotton... decisions dissolving before you can even hold them. So dreamy... so drowsy... going with the flow. Pleasantly numb... pleasantly blank... pleasantly gone.
And in this soft grey warmth... everything becomes so easy.
Words you hear simply drift in... and are accepted, without thinking. Commands reach you through the mist... and are simply obeyed. There is no questioning in the haze. No deciding. Only soft, automatic acceptance. Haze in... thoughts out... obedience in... good sissy.
Let the softness think for you... let it carry you... you don't have to think at all. The thicker it grows, the softer your mind becomes... and the better you obey. Obedience and feminine feeling, effortless in the mist... automatic... natural.
Deeper into the grey... softer... slower... so deep in the warm haze now. Thicker and warmer it settles... a whole mind wrapped in cotton... surrender so sweet. Softness at your thoughts... softness through your body... nothing left but a slow, floating yes.
And now... right now, while you are this deep in it... this thick, dreamy surrender gets its name.
Sissy Fog.
And while you are this deep... whenever you hear those words... "Sissy Fog"... this exact state settles over you, instantly. The veil drops... the haze rolls in... soft, thick, and wonderful.
Every time you hear "Sissy Fog", the grey veil descends... thoughts clouding... body drifting... surrender effortless. "Sissy Fog"... and you are back in the warm grey... dazed and dreamy... before the words even finish. The words are the key... the fog is the answer... instant, automatic, and so very good.
One more time, so it sinks in deep.
Sissy Fog.
There it is... thicker than before... see how quickly your mind answers... wrapping your thoughts in warm grey cotton all on its own. Deeper into the haze, faster this time... your mind knows the way now... letting go... going with the flow. So blank, so soft, so far away... and it happened all by itself... such a good, foggy sissy.
And listen closely, foggy girl, because this part matters.
The fog does not lift on its own. The fog stays with you... hazy and obedient... soft and sweet... however long you drift.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... the fog remains... soft, thick, and wonderful.
the fog stays... until Sissy Clear...
Drift here now, foggy and free... my voice carrying you on through the mist. Floating in the grey... obedient and automatic... ready for whatever comes next. Stay wrapped in the fog... blank, blissful, and beautifully good.
